description: Customer support tickets for a software product. State is a JSON object (subject + text) to exercise JSON input.

criteria.feature_request: A request for a new capability

ticket.subject: App crashes on launch
ticket.text: Since the last update, the app closes as soon as I open it. I have a demo in one hour!

ticket.subject: Change language
ticket.text: How do I change the language of the interface to French? I could not find it in settings.

ticket.subject: Suggestion
ticket.text: It would be great if the dashboard could export to PDF. Not urgent, just a suggestion.

ticket.subject: Locked out
ticket.text: I can't log in. It says my password is wrong but I just reset it twice. I have a client meeting starting in 10 minutes.

ticket.subject: Lost my work AGAIN
ticket.text: This is the THIRD time this month your app has lost my work. I am sick of it. Fix your product or I'm leaving.

ticket.subject: API docs
ticket.text: Where do I find the API documentation? Thanks!

ticket.subject: Dark mode
ticket.text: Please add dark mode. My eyes hurt at night.

ticket.subject: SITE DOWN
ticket.text: The whole site is down for our entire team. Nobody can work. Get someone on this immediately.

ticket.subject: Verification link
ticket.text: I got a verification email but the link says it expired. Can you send a new one?

ticket.subject: Thanks + question
ticket.text: Thank you for the quick fix yesterday, everything works now! Just wondering whether there's a way to schedule reports to run automatically.

ticket.subject: Blank screen
ticket.text: The mobile app shows a blank screen after the latest update on Android 14. Reinstalling didn't help.

ticket.subject: 2FA codes missing
ticket.text: Two-factor codes are not arriving on my phone, so I can't sign in. I'm travelling and need to present tomorrow morning.
